description: PBOC open market operations for one day (公开市场业务操作): each operation's type (7-day or overnight reverse repo, Hong Kong central bank bill issue), tenor, accepted amount in units of 100 million CNY and rate, parsed from that day's official trading announcement, plus the announcement text. Pass `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) or omit it for the latest day. A day with no announcement (weekend, holiday, or no operation) returns found:false with reason no_operation_notice and the nearest announcement dates; a day with a zero-volume 7-day reverse repo returns the zero operation explicitly. Answers "today's PBOC reverse repo", "how much liquidity did the PBOC inject on 2026-11-10", "PBOC 7-day reverse repo rate". Keyless, sourced live from the People's Bank of China.

date.description: Operation date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest announced day.
